name: factory
description: Run herdr software factories through this session: it ticks every run, runs a hidden patrol subagent as its manager, and draws a live console.

autopilot.title: Let a hidden patrol subagent drive the factory
autopilot.description: On: a hidden patrol subagent patrols the factory, so the main chat stays free for you. It wakes on mail for the manager (a stuck station, a worker's question, a gate, a finished run), on a worker blocked on a prompt, and every 10 minutes while workers run or a rig with a goal has room, and acts on them. Off: mail only shows in the pane and a toast.

pm.title: Let a hidden pm subagent rank each rig's next work
pm.description: On: a hidden 'pm' subagent ranks each rig's ready work into a plan once an hour, and again soon after a run finishes. It has no Bash: it only ranks and explains, and the factory CLI writes the plan and files any finding. The patrol and dispatch then use that plan while it is fresh (under 2 hours old). Off: they keep today's order. A manager session that started before Agent joined the engine's own tool list cannot spawn the pm. With no Agent tool, the pm stops at once, shows a red line on the Rigs tab, and writes one pm-log.jsonl entry; restarting the manager clears this (see CHANGELOG, claude-factory-dun).

briefer.title: Let a hidden briefer subagent write each gate's evidence brief
briefer.description: On: once for each gate visit, a hidden 'briefer' subagent reads the pull request, the verify and review summaries, and the run's goal, then writes a brief of 8 lines or fewer into the gate's decision item. It has no Bash: the factory CLI gathers the facts first and stores the cleaned brief after. The person still runs `factory decide`; the briefer never can. Off: the Interview tab's gate item shows no brief.
